name: beethoven-base
summary: The shared parsers and rules of the three Beethoven editions: pure TypeScript each edition carries byte for byte inside its own source tree and compiles. Thirteen modules (profile.ts before design step 9, the other twelve at it): the meaning of what the grid writes, the Claude Code link shapes, the site profile reader, the sign-in, strip and redaction rules, the engine's account list, the ssh options and the diagnostics engine. One export per edition lists the modules that edition takes.

exports.summary: What the desktop edition compiles into its own source tree: the two Claude Code link shapes (links.ts); the HPCW-STEP lines and progress.log (steps.ts); status.json, connection.json and the worker's status line (status.ts); the gate's lines and answers (gate.ts); when a run is stale and which link to open (run.ts); the next step for each failure, as a code (meaning.ts); the site profile reader (profile.ts); the redaction rules (redact.ts); the engine's account list (accounts.ts); and the ssh options with the host key comparison (sshopts.ts).

What the browser edition compiles into its own source tree: the two Claude Code link shapes (links.ts); the HPCW-STEP lines and progress.log (steps.ts); status.json, connection.json and the worker's status line (status.ts); the gate's lines and answers (gate.ts); when a run is stale and which link to open (run.ts); the next step for each failure, as a code (meaning.ts); the site profile reader (profile.ts); the redaction rules (redact.ts); the subscription sign-in rule (signin.ts); and the diagnostics engine (diagnostics.ts).

What the VS Code edition compiles into its own source tree, laptop side (design step 13): the two Claude Code link shapes (links.ts); the redaction rules (redact.ts); the engine's account list (accounts.ts); the ssh options with the host key comparison (sshopts.ts); the subscription sign-in rule (signin.ts); the variables taken away before Claude Code starts (strip.ts); and the diagnostics engine (diagnostics.ts). None of them imports another. profile.ts and the grid's readers join it at VS Code 7.0.0 (design step 16).
